fact: The Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy (MPTEN) lists among its 2025 achievements an operational Internet exchange point (IXP) in Guinea, which lets Guinean operators exchange traffic directly without going through abroad; no exchange name, city or member count is given.
Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 active exchange point in Guinea with 10 members as of November 2026.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Guinea: IXP-GUINEE, Conakry.
